SAFETY FIXES applied after teleop incident. elbow_flex overshot encoder wrap (0-4095 uncalibrated range) -> stalled against hard stop, grinding sound. No damage (temp 29C, load 0 after). Fixes: (1) Follower calibration updated: elbow_flex now 24-4051, wrist_roll now 27-3892 (both were uncalibrated 0-4095). Other joints: union with prior. (2) teleop_6joint.py rewritten with 5 safety layers: range clamping (5% margin), startup equalization (follower moves to match leader before tracking starts), per-cycle step cap (MAX_STEP=80 counts/cycle), encoder wrap detection (halt joint if pos jumps >1500 counts), load monitoring (emergency stop if >75%). Speed lowered to 200.

TELEOP SAFETY + CALIBRATION update. Incident: elbow_flex stalled at hard stop (pos 160) after encoder wrap — grinding sound, no damage. Root cause: elbow_flex and wrist_roll calibration was 0-4095 (never swept). Fix 1: Follower recalibrated — elbow_flex 24-4051, wrist_roll 27-3892. Shared to ~/so101/shared/calibration.json. Fix 2: teleop_6joint.py now has cybernetic control loop: proportional speed (K=1.2 * error + 0.6 * leader_velocity feedforward), startup equalization, encoder wrap halt, load emergency stop. No more teleporting: speed scales with error so follower ramps smoothly. No more blind sending: follower tracking error printed every cycle.

TELEOP AUDIT + PLAN. Reviewed our teleop implementation against lerobot source and community practice. Findings: (1) Position mapping is CORRECT — homing_offset is hardware-applied, our range_min/range_max linear mapping is equivalent to lerobot normalize/unnormalize chain. (2) CRITICAL GAP: we never write to speed register (addr 46). Servo moves at default/last-set speed regardless of our position ramp. This causes loud/fast motor sounds. Fix: write proportional speed each cycle alongside goal_position — speed = K * abs(error) + feedforward. (3) No encoder wrap detection (jumps >1500 counts should halt joint). (4) 20Hz loop, no velocity feedforward from leader velocity register (addr 58). (5) Joint-space is pragmatic and fine for dataset recording. EE-space (FK/IK via URDF) is theoretically superior but not needed now. NEXT ACTION: add speed register (addr 46) writes to server teleop loop with proportional control. This is the single highest-impact fix. teleop_6joint.py (session 9) already has the right formula: speed = clamp(K_SPEED * abs(error) + FF_GAIN * leader_vel, SPEED_MIN, SPEED_MAX). We should port this into app.py poll loop. Label persistence fix already deployed. Startup equalization already deployed.

Session 10 (this session): MCP testing plan phases 1-4 executed. All MCP tools work live. KEY FIXES: (1) Safety framework: shared/safety.json defines 7 principles (P1-P7) and all thresholds. Both ui/app.py and mcp_server.py import from it. (2) Ramped moves: /api/move accepts 'ramped':true, steps at 60 counts/cycle — no more teleporting. MCP sends ramped by default. (3) Pre-flight checks in MCP: refuses moves during teleop, checks temps, warns on large moves. (4) Stall recovery grace: 2s window after commanded moves where stall detection is suppressed, so motors can escape stall zones. (5) Elbow_flex range_min raised 24->300 (desk collision prevention). (6) start_teleop/stop_teleop MCP tools added. teleop_active now in robot_state.json. (7) Session log backfilled for sessions 1-3,6. Hook instructions strengthened. (8) Testing plan fully updated with results. STILL NEEDS: (a) Claude Code restart to pick up new MCP server with pre-flight checks. (b) Speed register writes (addr 46) in UI teleop loop for proportional speed. (c) Full calibration round-trip test via MCP. (d) First dataset recording episode.

Leader velocity feedforward added to UI teleop loop (commit b2d1f41). Formula: speed = 1.2*|error| + 0.6*|leader_vel|, clamped [80,500]. Reads PRESENT_SPEED_ADDR (58) each cycle during live tracking. Speed register writes (addr 46) were already ported by parallel worker. Encoder wrap detection also already present. Server needs restart to pick up changes. Speed register open question resolved — now in session_log open_questions: test with restart, check leader vel register returns useful values at 20Hz.

Ramped moves now read actual position each cycle (commit 05d5c10). Previously tracked assumed positions in a 'sent' dict — would drift if motor stalled under load. Now reads board['positions'] (poll loop, 20Hz fresh) so ramp self-corrects. Implements P2 (know before move) at the servo level. Other worker is making parallel changes: always-on calibration tracking, exception handling in auto_scan, updated MCP cal tools. No conflicts — our changes are to different sections of app.py.

Session 11: (1) MCP server expanded to 22 tools: added selftest (physical joint probe with pre-flight), search_conversations, list_conversations. (2) Conversation history indexer (scripts/index_conversations.py) reads raw Claude Code JSONL transcripts, builds searchable index at shared/conversation_history/index.jsonl. First run: 301 messages from 3 sessions. SessionStart hook auto-indexes in background. (3) Collision detection added to ramped moves: load > 350 immediately stops joint and disables torque. Teleop collision detection (by parallel worker) freezes joint, resumes when load < 150. Two-tier: collision=350 (reactive), stall=800 (backstop). (4) UI server restarted with collision detection live. Commits: 7b17e2f (selftest+indexer+search), cf932a8 (collision detection). NEXT: test collision detection threshold tuning, MCP restart for new tools, end-to-end UX flow.

Session 11b: Cybernetic world model. (1) /api/autocalibrate probes joints via load feedback — finds physical limits. (2) /api/workspace/probe maps obstacles across joint pairs — probed elbow_flex at 8 shoulder_lift positions, found desk at ~100-150. (3) P9 safety principle: workspace limits in safety.json clamp positions in /api/move and teleop. Three-layer safety: workspace->calibration->collision. (4) Tested: sent elbow_flex=50, clamped to 255. Desk can't be hit through any code path. (5) 25 MCP tools, all auto-approved. Commits: 7b17e2f, cf932a8, dda0648.

Session 12 (continuation): Fixed equalization safety. (1) Collision detection now active during equalization with 2x threshold (700 vs 350). Previously disabled entirely — elbow pushed into desk at load=1000. (2) Workspace limits applied to equalization targets (line 2192). (3) Root cause of desk collision: leader elbow at 4058, follower at 108 (on desk), equalization ramps 3526 counts but motor cannot physically lift off desk surface. Collision detection catches this and freezes joint. (4) Physical fix needed: match leader to follower position before starting teleop, or manually lift follower off desk. Server restarted with both fixes live.

Session 12b: GitHub repo live at github.com/JDerekLomas/so101. Wave script (scripts/wave.py) with cybernetic sense-act-verify loop. Shoulder raises to 1897, wrist/gripper converge, but wrist_roll stalls during wave (load=248) and elbow stuck on desk (pos=148). Leader elbow motor 3 stuck at 4058 (dead encoder). Added exclude_joints to teleop, collision detection during equalization (2x threshold), workspace limits on equalization targets. Key insight: server P4 torque timeout too short for gravity-loaded poses — direct serial scripts needed for sustained torque.
